subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this grouped one-Claw/one-new-agent schema and gated read-only CLI as the compatibility base for the remaining Claws implementation stack?
rationale: The patch creates durable manifest, CLI, environment-variable, planning, ownership, and JSON-output surfaces; repository inspection can assess implementation quality but cannot authorize that product contract while its RFC is still open.

options.title: Approve the gated base
options.body: Accept the RFC direction and land this read-only slice after current-head checks complete, keeping mutation in separately reviewed owner slices.

options.title: Narrow before adoption
options.body: Reduce the initial schema or defer selected package, MCP, cron, or agent fields before downstream work hardens them into compatibility requirements.

options.title: Continue RFC incubation
options.body: Keep this PR and its dependent stack open until maintainers settle the durable ownership and lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the gated base
recommendation.body: Accept the RFC direction and land this read-only slice after current-head checks complete, keeping mutation in separately reviewed owner slices.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest visible reviewer for the product model and the canonical owner-boundary requirements implemented by the current head.
